site_agency: Build the home page of 'Northlight', a small design studio, as a desktop website: a top navigation (Work, Services, About, Journal) with a 'Start a project' button; a hero with the headline 'Brands that feel like themselves', a short paragraph and one button; a grid of six case studies, each a drawn picture, the client's name, the kind of work and the year; a band with four services, each with an icon, a name and one sentence; a row of three figures (120 projects, 14 years, 9 people); a client quote with the person's name and role; a closing band that asks for a project, with an email field and a button; a footer with three columns of links.
site_changelog: Build the changelog page of 'Relay', an API platform, as a desktop website: a top navigation (Docs, API, Changelog, Status) with 'Sign in'; a page title 'Changelog' with one line under it and a row of filter chips (All, Added, Improved, Fixed); then six entries down the page, each with its date at the left and at the right a version number, a title, a tag (Added, Improved or Fixed), two or three bullet points and sometimes a short code sample; a sidebar at the right with 'Subscribe to updates' (an email field and a button) and links to the last four versions; a footer.
site_event: Build the page of 'Signal 2027', a two-day conference for data teams, as a desktop website: a top navigation (Speakers, Schedule, Venue, Tickets) with a 'Get tickets' button; a hero with the name, the dates and the city, a countdown of days, hours and minutes, and two buttons; eight speakers in a grid with a drawn portrait, name, role and company; the schedule of day one as a list of six sessions with time, title, speaker and track; three ticket kinds with price, what is included and a button, the middle one recommended; the venue with a drawn map, the address and how to get there; a footer.
site_restaurant: Build the website of 'Olmo', a neighborhood Italian restaurant, as a desktop page: a top navigation (Menu, Reservations, Private dining, Visit) with a 'Book a table' button; a hero with a drawn picture, the line 'Wood fire, handmade pasta, long evenings' and the opening hours for today; the menu in three columns (Antipasti, Primi, Secondi), five dishes each with name, a short description and price; a reservation band with a date, a time, a party size and a button that says how many tables are left; two reviews; the address with a map and the hours for each day; a footer.
site_jobs: Build the careers page of 'Fathom', a climate data company, as a desktop website: a top navigation (Product, Customers, Company, Careers) with 'Sign in'; a hero with the headline 'Work on the planet's hardest data', one paragraph and the count of open roles; four values in a row, each with an icon, a word and a sentence; the open roles as a list filtered by team (All, Engineering, Science, Design, Sales) and by place, each role with its title, team, place, kind (Full-time, Contract) and an 'Apply' link, grouped by team with a count; a band about benefits with six items; a closing line for people who see no fitting role, with a button; a footer.
app_analytics: Build the explore screen of 'Lumen', a product analytics app, as a desktop app window: a sidebar with the product name and navigation (Home, Explore, Funnels, Retention, Cohorts, Settings); a top bar with the title 'Explore', a date range control and 'Save chart'; a query builder panel with the event chosen ('Checkout completed'), a 'grouped by' choice (Plan) and two filters shown as removable chips with an 'Add filter' button; a large line chart with three series and a legend; under it a table with one row per plan (Free, Team, Business): the count, the change against the previous period and a small trend line; a panel at the right with saved charts.
app_calendar: Build the week screen of 'Cadence', a scheduling app, as a desktop app window: a sidebar with a 'New event' button, a small month calendar with today marked, and a list of calendars with colored checkboxes (Work, Personal, Team, Holidays); a top bar with the week's dates, previous and next buttons, 'Today', and a switch between Day, Week and Month; the week as seven columns with the hours 8 to 18 down the side and nine events placed as colored blocks with their title and time, one of them selected; at the right a details panel for the selected event: title, time, place, three guests with their replies, a note and 'Edit' and 'Delete' buttons.
app_files: Build the files screen of 'Stowage', a team file manager, as a desktop app window: a sidebar with the product name, 'Upload' button, navigation (All files, Shared with me, Recent, Starred, Trash) and a storage meter (62 of 100 GB); a top bar with breadcrumbs (All files / Design / Brand refresh), a search field, and a switch between list and grid; four folders as tiles with name and item count; then the files as a table with a checkbox, an icon by kind, the name, the owner with an avatar, the date modified and the size, two rows selected; a bar that appears for the selection with Share, Move, Download and Delete; a details panel at the right for the last selected file with a preview, who can access it and its recent activity.
app_deal: Build the deal screen of 'Pipeline', a sales CRM, as a desktop app window: a sidebar with the product name and navigation (Inbox, Deals, Contacts, Companies, Reports); a top bar with the breadcrumb Deals / Northwind renewal, the deal's stage as steps (Lead, Qualified, Proposal, Negotiation, Won) with Proposal current, and 'Mark as won' and 'More' buttons; at the left a column of facts (amount $48,000, close date, owner, probability 60% as a meter, next step); in the middle tabs (Activity, Notes, Emails, Files) with the activity as a timeline of six items (a call, an email, a note, a stage change) each with who, when and a line of detail, and a box to add a note; at the right the contacts on the deal (three people with role and email) and the company card.
app_users: Build the members screen of 'Bastion', an admin console, as a desktop app window: a sidebar with the product name and navigation (Overview, Members, Roles, Audit log, Billing, Security); a top bar with the title 'Members', the count, and 'Invite member'; four figures in a row (Members 48, Pending invites 3, Admins 5, Two-factor on 92%); a bar with a search field, a role filter and a status filter; a table of ten members with avatar and name, email, role as a select, status (Active, Invited, Suspended) as a badge, two-factor as a check or a warning, last active, and a menu; a pending invites panel under it with three rows and 'Resend' and 'Revoke'; pagination.
